primary_claim: SAE features related to a finetuning target change significantly more than other features after finetuning (Intersection Difference Rate greater than 15%), enabling a low-cost automated method to audit what a model was finetuned on.

effect.metric: Intersection Difference Rate (task-specific vs general dataset SAE feature overlap)

stated_future_work: We will conduct more comprehensive experiments to understand the reasons behind this phenomenon in the future
perform a full ablation study on data size and model architecture
limitations_stated: due to time and other limits, we didn't perform a full ablation study to our conclusions, e.g. ablation on data size and model architecture
we do not have a thorough analysis on the mechanism behind this phenomenon
quote: the intersection mean difference rate is bigger than 15%, suggesting that this change is significant
